Basic Attack
 Starry Heart Throb

sections.heading: BASIC ATTACK:
sections.text: Liino can perform up to 5 basic attack sequences, dealing Electric DMG to the enemy. When performing a Finisher on an enemy, Liino deals massive Electric DMG and restores some SP.

sections.heading: FINISHER:
sections.text:
Battle Skill
 Dazzling Focus

 Costs a small amount of SP to deal Electric DMG to enemies, and then enters Vocalist Stance for an extended period. While this stance is active, Liino grants the entire team an ATK Boost, provides HP Treatment to operators within range, and periodically performs additional attacks on nearby enemies.

 Combo Skill
 Delightful Harmonics

 Deals Electric DMG to enemies, grants HP Treatment to the controlled operator, and gains additional Ultimate Energy to herself.

 Trigger: While Vocalist Stance is active, when an Arts Reaction is consumed or applied on an enemy.

 Ultimate
 Dawnstar Concerto

 Liino gives HP Treatment to the entire team while entering Cosmovoice Stance for a period of time, dealing DMG and forcibly applying Electrification to enemies in a large area of effect (AOE). While active, this stance continuously grants powerful buffs and HP Treatment to allied operators while dealing continuous DMG to enemies.
